import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def exponentiation_precond (b e : UInt64) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  b.toNat ^ e.toNat ≤ (2 ^ 64 - 1)
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
def exponentiation_by_squaring_aux (base exp acc : Nat) : Nat :=
  if exp = 0 then
    acc
  else if exp % 2 = 0 then
    exponentiation_by_squaring_aux (base * base) (exp / 2) acc
  else
    exponentiation_by_squaring_aux (base * base) (exp / 2) (acc * base)
termination_by exp
decreasing_by
  all_goals
    apply Nat.div_lt_self
    · omega
    · omega
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def exponentiation (b e : UInt64) (h_precond : exponentiation_precond b e) : UInt64 :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  let result :=
    exponentiation_by_squaring_aux b.toNat e.toNat 1
  if h : result < UInt64.size then
    ⟨⟨result, h⟩⟩
  else
    0
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def exponentiation_postcond (b e : UInt64) (result : UInt64) (h_precond : exponentiation_precond b e) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  result.toNat = b.toNat ^ e.toNat
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
lemma exponentiation_square_pow (b k : Nat) :
    (b * b) ^ k = b ^ (2 * k) := by
  simpa [pow_two] using (pow_mul b 2 k).symm

lemma exponentiation_odd_square_pow (acc b k : Nat) :
    (acc * b) * (b * b) ^ k = acc * b ^ (2 * k + 1) := by
  rw [exponentiation_square_pow, pow_add]
  simp
  ac_rfl

lemma exponentiation_by_squaring_aux_correct
    (base exp acc : Nat) :
    exponentiation_by_squaring_aux base exp acc =
      acc * base ^ exp := by
  induction exp using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing base acc with
  | h exp ih =>
      by_cases hzero : exp = 0
      · subst exp
        simp [exponentiation_by_squaring_aux]
      · have hexp_pos : 0 < exp := Nat.pos_of_ne_zero hzero
        have hhalf : exp / 2 < exp := by
          apply Nat.div_lt_self hexp_pos
          omega
        by_cases heven : exp % 2 = 0
        · rw [exponentiation_by_squaring_aux, if_neg hzero, if_pos heven]
          rw [ih (exp / 2) hhalf (base * base) acc]

            Nat.mod_add_div exp 2
          have hexp : exp = 2 * (exp / 2) := by
            omega
          calc
            acc * (base * base) ^ (exp / 2) =
                acc * base ^ (2 * (exp / 2)) := by
                  rw [exponentiation_square_pow]
            _ = acc * base ^ exp :=
              congrArg (fun n => acc * base ^ n) hexp.symm
        · rw [exponentiation_by_squaring_aux, if_neg hzero, if_neg heven]
          rw [ih (exp / 2) hhalf (base * base) (acc * base)]
          have hrem_lt : exp % 2 < 2 := Nat.mod_lt exp (by omega)
          have hdecomp : exp % 2 + 2 * (exp / 2) = exp :=
            Nat.mod_add_div exp 2
          have hrem : exp % 2 = 1 := by
            omega
          have hexp : exp = 2 * (exp / 2) + 1 := by
            omega
          calc
            (acc * base) * (base * base) ^ (exp / 2) =
                acc * base ^ (2 * (exp / 2) + 1) :=
              exponentiation_odd_square_pow acc base (exp / 2)
            _ = acc * base ^ exp :=
              congrArg (fun n => acc * base ^ n) hexp.symm
-- !benchmark @end lemma

-- Proof content
theorem exponentiation_postcond_satisfied (b e : UInt64)
    (h_precond : exponentiation_precond b e) :
    exponentiation_postcond b e (exponentiation b e h_precond) h_precond := by
  -- !benchmark @start proof
  have hlt :
      exponentiation_by_squaring_aux b.toNat e.toNat 1 < UInt64.size := by
    rw [exponentiation_by_squaring_aux_correct]
    simp only [one_mul]
    norm_num [UInt64.size, exponentiation_precond] at h_precond ⊢
    omega
  unfold exponentiation
  rw [dif_pos hlt]
  change
    exponentiation_by_squaring_aux b.toNat e.toNat 1 =
      b.toNat ^ e.toNat
  simpa using
    (exponentiation_by_squaring_aux_correct b.toNat e.toNat 1)
  -- !benchmark @end proof
